notes: Variant WLC.PRO.31.18.v003 is underdetermined and resolved to r00-base; the qere fallback remains among the readings the English permits, so rule 53 does not apply.
'out' stays with the verb under rule 44: 'goeth' alone does not write the extinguishing of כָּבָה, so the particle completes the lexeme rather than adding a direction the Hebrew omits.
The article of בַלָּיְלָה is unrepresented, the ASV writing 'by night' with no 'the' (rules 12, 29).
